train_detector: train a detector by running the script with a config file path and optional work directory
enable_amp_training: enable automatic-mixed-precision training by passing the --amp flag to the training script
resume_training: resume training from a checkpoint by specifying the checkpoint path or auto-resuming from the latest checkpoint
override_config_options: override settings in the config file by passing key-value pairs via the --cfg-options flag
scale_learning_rate: enable automatically scaling the learning rate based on batch size by passing the --auto-scale-lr flag
